= paragraph-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Parser checks
:mansource: acdc
:value: expanded

== Name
paragraph-subs - preserve substitutions in styled paragraphs

== Synopsis

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+attributes,+macros"]
S01 code;; *bold* {value} https://example.org[link] <1>
S02 next:: _italic_ <!--2-->

<1> Enabled substitutions in the source paragraph.
<2> Formatted continuation.

//-

[literal,subs=-callouts]
S03 literal;; <1>
S04 literal:: \<2>

//-

[listing,subs=none]
S05 listing;; {value} *literal* <1>

//-

[source,text]
S06 inactive:: footnote:unused[No note.] indexterm2:[No entry] <1>

<1> Default substitutions do not register these macros.

//-

[source,text,subs=+macros]
S07 active:: footnote:used[One note.] <1>

<1> The note is registered exactly once.

[verse,subs=none]
S08 verse;; {value} *literal*

Reuse footnote:used[].
